title: Generate artifact readiness report for dataset model camera handoff
user_business_goal: Prepare the next implementation loop by generating a single metadata-only readiness report for dataset, model, camera, and QC feedback artifacts before live hardware/model work starts.
out_of_scope: raw images, videos, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Add an app-level helper that builds an artifact readiness report from the existing artifact intake validation result and optional QC labeling review pack.
The report includes contract version, generated_at, readiness lanes, blockers, recommended next actions, source references, and production_authority=false.
The report distinguishes shadow model integration readiness from live camera readiness and production release authority.
The report fails closed on invalid or malformed input and never treats missing or invalid artifacts as ready.
Add a CLI under scripts/flange_qc_v2/** that reads an artifact intake directory, optionally reads a QC labeling review pack JSON, and writes the report JSON to stdout or an output file.
The report does not include raw images, raw datasets, full feedback rows, notebooks, model weights, camera credentials, secrets, or production PASS/NG authority.
Update MLOps/readiness/data-model/test docs and add DoR/QA evidence.
Existing artifact intake, MLOps handoff, feedback export, labeling pack, HMI, detector bridge, and product CI behavior remains valid.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 artifact readiness report, dataset/model/camera handoff, QC feedback labeling review pack, no hardware.
retrieved_decisions: Camera/live capture remains blocked until hardware approval.
retrieved_lessons: Use validated metadata contracts and fail closed.
Do not mix review readiness with production authority.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-039 PR to remove the artifact readiness report helper, CLI, tests, docs, and gate evidence. Existing artifact intake, feedback export, labeling review pack, detector bridge, HMI, and product CI behavior remain valid.
